metadata.title: Dried Fish & Cabbage Salad | Northeastern Recipe
metadata.description:
This is one of my favorite and quick and easy to make side dish recipe. This was given to me by one of my very close friend whom I know from school days. The pungent and umami flavour of dry fish roasted in mustard oil with load of onion and green chilies mixed with the raw cabbage and its crunchy texture is a match made in heaven. 

The ingredients required are;
Cabbage 250 gms
Mustard oil - 1 Tbsp
Onion - 1 large one
Garlic - 7-8 cloves
Chilies - 7 -8 
Dried Fish - 99-10 small ones
Salt as required
